jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.


#### **The Role**



Global Seller Onboarding Specialistsmanage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project\-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process. They’ll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square’s platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer\-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions.



A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1\) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2\) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3\) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4\) support Square’s international expansion efforts.


* "Global Seller Onboarding Specialists manage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process."
* "Looking for willingness to travel as part of the job (around 10%) and most likely majority of the onsites will be in and around New York/NY.

#### **You Will**


* Drive world\-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s sellers, ensuring accountability to go\-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.
* Cultivate strong cross\-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.
* Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success.  

Master Square’s platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject\-matter expert.
* Lead high\-impact, multi\-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.
* Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.
* Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process.

#### **You Have**


* BA/BS degree, preferably
* 2\-3 years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success.
* An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.
* Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.
* Ability to thrive within ambiguity and operate independently.
* Ability to drive and manage multiple cross\-functional initiatives simultaneously; strong time management, and excellent written \& verbal communication skills.
* Proven track record of success in delivering multiple complex projects in the technology industry while partnering with external and internal clients to attain deliverables.
* An ability to learn quickly as new products and organisational changes are released.
* Previous Project Management experience is expected.
* Experience in the POS, Payments or Tech industries is a plus.
* Experience in hardware installation and network configuration is a plus.
* Located in PST or MST time zone.


**Your typical day will include:**


* Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation.
* Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.
* Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.

Risk Management - Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
### **The Company**


Empyrean Solutions specializes in financial risk and performance management solutions for banks and credit unions. Empyrean offers a comprehensive suite of software products supporting asset\-liability management, budgeting and financial planning, capital stress testing, profitability, and funds transfer pricing. Our solutions empower financial institutions to manage risk, improve decision‑making, and build stable long‑term earnings.

### **The Team**


The Professional Services team is comprised of financial modelers, data analysts, and product experts who help clients realize the full value of Empyrean’s software. Through consulting, implementation services, and training, the team partners closely with financial institutions to support successful adoption and long‑term use of Empyrean’s solutions.

### **Responsibilities**

* Deliver successful implementations of Empyrean's ALM, LST, FTP, Model IQ, Capital Stress Testing, and CECL solutions, taking clients from project initiation through go\-live on a well\-configured, sustainable model.
* Translate each client's interest rate risk, liquidity risk, capital, credit loss, transfer pricing, and model governance objectives into an implementation approach their team can own and maintain.
* Ensure balance sheet structures, cashflow assumptions, rate and capital stress scenarios, and CECL/ACL methodologies are configured to produce accurate, decision\-ready results.
* Ensure client data supporting these solutions is complete, reconciled, and reliable as the foundation for modeling and reporting.
* Enable clients to produce and trust their IRR, liquidity, capital, transfer pricing, and credit loss reporting across product, instrument, and organizational views.
* Support model development and governance workflows within Model IQ, helping clients build, test, and maintain defensible models.
* Equip clients to independently administer the solution and build their own reporting through effective training and knowledge transfer.
* Advise clients on best practices for data management, reporting, and balance sheet risk measurement.
* Serve as a liaison between the client user community and Empyrean's product management team, channeling client needs into product direction.
* Apply AI\-assisted tools and repeatable processes to deliver value more efficiently and consistently, and contribute to improving those processes over time.
* Safeguard sensitive customer data by following all applicable policies and controls and using approved channels for data transmission.

### **Experience and Education**

* Degree in finance, accounting, economics, mathematics, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in banking, financial services, risk management, FPA, or financial technology.
* Solid understanding of the banking industry, accounting, and financial statements.
* Strong knowledge of Excel and experience working with large datasets.
* Strong attention to detail and good planning and organization skills.
* Experience with business intelligence tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
* Experience with statistical or behavioral model development (e.g., regression\-based NMD, prepayment, or PD/LGD modeling).
* Comfortable following and improving structured processes.
* Demonstrated AI literacy in a professional environment and sound judgment about when and how to apply it, including awareness of data\-handling and confidentiality considerations.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Working knowledge of asset/liability management (ALM), interest rate risk, Capital Stress Testing, and liquidity risk concepts, including liquidity stress testing (LST).
* Working knowledge of Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP).
* Familiarity with CECL/ALLL methodologies and allowance for credit loss calculations.
* Familiarity with model risk management, model validation, or model governance frameworks (e.g., Model IQ).
* Familiarity with regulatory capital planning and stress testing frameworks (e.g., CCAR/DFAST\-style).
* Familiarity with fixed\-income cashflow calculation and fixed income math.
* Experience implementing ALM, liquidity, Capital Stress Testing, or CECL solutions at a financial institution.
* Experience with financial data management, ETL tools, and Microsoft Power Query.
* Knowledge of SQL or other data\-analysis tools.
* Prior consulting, implementation, or customer\-success experience.
* Experience building or improving repeatable, AI\-assisted workflows.

### **Location**


This position is open to remote candidates in the US.

### **Compensation**


The typical starting salary within the full salary range for this position can vary. Factors which may affect starting salary include geographic market, relevant skills/experience, education, and other qualifications. Select roles or locations are eligible for additional incentive plans which will be shared during the interview process.

  

Base Salary Range: $75,000 \-$85,000  



  

*Empyrean Solutions is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees. Many of our roles have flexible requirements and we encourage you to apply regardless of whether you meet every qualification.*

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Role Type:** Permanent

**Location:** Remote, Canada


**Compensation:** $70,000\-80,000 CAD base salary

 **About us**


ACTO is an Intelligent Field Excellence (IFE) platform built for life sciences that unifies human intelligence with Empathetic AI to help Sales, Medical, Market Access, and Marketing teams improve customer engagement and brand performance. With ACTO, biopharma companies can ensure field professionals are always competent, confident, and credible in face\-to\-face HCP (healthcare professional) interactions As a validated platform compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and SOC 2 Type II certified, ACTO is the trusted partner for intelligent field excellence in the life sciences industry.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


In this expanded role, you will lead end\-to\-end implementations of ACTO Omnichannel across Pharmaceutical and Biotech organizations. You will operate as both a trusted onboarding strategist and the primary project manager, responsible for guiding customers through implementation, ensuring cross\-functional alignment, maintaining project governance, and driving successful go\-lives.


Your blended responsibilities allow for a seamless experience for clients, combining ACTO platform expertise, onboarding best practices, and a structured project management approach to deliver measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

***Implementation \& Customer Enablement***
-------------------------------------------

* Lead the implementation of ACTO Omnichannel capabilities for Established \& Emerging Pharmaceutical companies, as well as Enterprise and SMB MedTech companies.
* Understand the customer’s goals, success criteria, and strategic vision for ACTO, and develop a clear \& achievable implementation plan.
* Confidently provide product demonstrations and guidance, including ACTO’s AI\-enabled capabilities and appropriate use cases, to ensure stakeholder buy‑in ahead of go‑live.
* Build strong relationships with customers by equipping them with the knowledge, tools, and confidence needed for long‑term adoption and success.
* Coach clients on strategies for running a successful launch and sustaining adoption.
* Work cross\-functionally to improve implementation strategies, processes, and best practices, including identifying repeatable workflows that can be enhanced or automated through AI.
* Provide structured feedback to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to reduce friction and enhance the implementation experience.

***Project Planning \& Governance***
------------------------------------

* Own the creation, maintenance, and communication of the project plan, including scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and roles/responsibilities; leverage AI tools to strengthen planning, sequencing, risk identification, and prioritization.
* Lead all communications and sessions, ensuring all stakeholders understand objectives, deliverables, and success metrics; use AI\-generated meeting notes, including Zoom AI notes, to support pre\-call planning, prepare and send client agendas in advance, capture decisions and action items, and send timely follow\-up emails.
* Maintain clear responsibility mapping for complex implementations.
* Facilitate regular project governance meetings with client stakeholders and ACTO leadership, as required.

***Execution \& Cross‑Functional Coordination***
------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate tasks across Product, Data, Engineering, Sales, Services, and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless execution, as needed.
* Track deliverables, dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating strategically to maintain project momentum.
* Ensure internal teams are aligned and informed of project status, upcoming needs, and customer expectations.
* Lead change management discussions when customer‑side scope, timelines, or requirements shift.
* Use approved AI tools, including ACTO AI and, where authorized, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other platforms, to streamline repetitive administrative work, improve efficiency, and create capacity for higher\-value client and project activities.

***Risk, Issue \& Change Management***
--------------------------------------

* Proactively identify potential risks and challenges during implementation.
* Develop and communicate mitigation plans to both clients and internal teams.
* Maintain a change log and ensure stakeholders approve adjustments to scope or timelines.
* Resolve both forecasted and unexpected issues, ensuring minimal disruption to the project schedule.

***Documentation \& Reporting***
--------------------------------

* Ensure thorough project tracking via Wrike, using AI\-generated meeting notes and summaries where appropriate to capture deadlines, decisions, action items, interactions, risks, and project progression.
* Maintain up\-to\-date project status reports, dashboards, timelines, and client\-facing materials for stakeholders and internal teams via Wrike, using AI tools to improve consistency, structure, and formatting while validating outputs for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure customer data privacy and security standards are followed throughout implementation, including when using AI tools and AI\-generated content.
* Provide structured handoffs to Customer Success Team post‑launch with complete and accurate documentation.

**Critical Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complexity.
* Exceptional project management and organizational skills, including the ability to leverage AI to improve planning, prioritization, and execution.
* Business empathy to foster deep, consultative relationships with clients.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in fast‑paced and dynamic environments.
* Attention to detail and a strong sense of accountability.
* Demonstrated resourcefulness and problem\-solving ability, with sound judgment in selecting, prompting, and validating AI tools for the task at hand.
* Eagerness to learn and continuously improve both team and customer outcomes, including staying current on evolving AI capabilities and sharing practical best practices with the team.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity to create project structure where needed.
* Working knowledge of generative AI and agentic AI, including when and how to use each appropriately and the ability to build simple AI agents or workflows to support individual productivity and recurring tasks.

  

**What you’ll enjoy about ACTO*** Industry\-leading, multiple award\-winning technology;
* Competitive compensation package;
* Being part of a mission driven organization with the ability to drive solutions that focus on improving patient outcomes;
* Joining a results\-driven and collaborative culture;
* Remote work with opportunities for in\-person collaboration;
* Company MacBook;
* Budget for work\-from\-home set\-up;
* Monthly work\-from\-home allowance;
* Flex hours (overlapping with our core hours);
* Participation in group benefits plan;
* Flexible PTO.

 *At ACTO, we believe diverse and inclusive teams perform better. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodations during our interview process.*

*We may use AI\-powered tools during parts of our hiring process to help review applications and support candidate communication. These tools are designed to assist our team, but all final hiring decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. If you have any questions or concerns about this process, please let us know. We thank everyone for their interest in ACTO. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist II - RCM- Salt Lake City, Utah
jobs.description:
Kipu is bettering the behavioral health landscape, helping treatment centers achieve the best outcomes and empowering patients and caregivers on every step of the recovery journey. Join us in our work to advance behavioral health care in our communities. Our innovative solutions support providers in treating addiction, eating disorders, and many other behavioral health conditions. Our EMR, CRM, and revenue cycle solutions help behavioral health facilities succeed in managing their patients' entire care journey, but it is through our people that we truly make a difference.

**Role Overview**


The Implementation Specialist II, RCM independently owns end\-to\-end implementations for behavioral health treatment centers on the Kipu RCM platform. You will lead discovery, translate billing and revenue cycle requirements into configuration decisions, train end users, and drive accountability for timelines and deliverables. This role operates with minimal oversight and contributes to team quality through mentorship and process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery \& Solution Design**

* Lead discovery conversations to identify client billing workflows, payer mix, compliance requirements, and constraints.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable RCM configuration decisions aligned with best practices.
* Challenge misaligned or risky requests respectfully, explaining tradeoffs and downstream billing impacts.

**Configuration \& Data Quality**

* Configure billing workflows, payer rules, fee schedules, and system settings accurately on the first pass.
* Troubleshoot RCM configuration issues by identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Validate billing data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before go\-live.

**Client Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver structured, goal\-oriented training that prepares clients to manage billing workflows independently.
* Equip client administrators to train their own teams on billing processes and system usage.
* Drive client accountability for tasks, timelines, and data deliverables.

**Project Delivery \& Risk Management**

* Own project documentation, ensuring records and project plans reflect reality.
* Identify risks early and document them with clear descriptions, owners, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional partners when scope, risk, or complexity warrants it.

**Go\-Live Readiness \& Adoption**

* Prepare clients for go\-live by validating that all billing readiness criteria are genuinely met.
* Support post\-go\-live adoption by tracking billing accuracy, claim submission rates, and early revenue cycle health.
* Contribute to process improvements and share learnings with peers and newer team members.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2\-4 years of experience implementing an RCM system, or a combination of RCM implementation and technical support.
* 6\+ years of revenue cycle management experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings and drive decisions.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing timelines.

**Preferred**

* Experience in behavioral health, mental health, or addiction treatment settings.
* Familiarity with EDI, ERA, clearinghouse processes, and payer enrollment workflows.
* Experience mentoring or supporting newer team members.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* Flexible paid time off.
* 11 Paid Holidays.
* Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance.
* Parental Leave.
* Pet Insurance.
* 401(K) with Company Match.

**Kipu Promise**


In an environment of rapid change, millions are struggling to cope. Kipu is here to help. Having shaped the industry for 10 years, today we focus on advancing our New Vision for the behavioral health ecosystem, evolving how it operates, interacts, communicates, and heals.


We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or disability status.

Description:
***RN \- Implementation Specialist***

**Job Summary:**


Responsible for applications training, electronic health records (EHR) training, onsite support for staff and provider use of hospital\-based clinical information systems. Onsite support includes initial clinical systems training and ongoing support. This position supports hospital’s strategic use of data to improve clinical, operational, financial and quality outcomes. It serves as a bridge between information technology, clinical operations and leadership by managing data conversion projects, developing reports and dashboards, conducting data analysis and supporting EHR optimization initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

* Provides initial and ongoing training to providers and staff on hospital applications, including EMR
* Collects input from care providers required for design and development of clinical information systems and collaborates in the design, build, analysis and improvement of clinical information systems
* Assists with data transfer assignments between the hospital and other entities.
* Assists with data mining and queries to write reports or data extractions to support all departments. Assignment includes the development and maintenance of departmental dashboards
* Ensure that the hospital achieves Meaningful Use targets, including communicating to relevant departments their progress in achieving Meaningful Use goals and assisting with the process to achieve the goals
* Participates in organization committees to share information about clinical user practices, needs and requirements. Facilitate communication with other support staff to respond to questions or provide additional support to care providers
* Communicates changes and/or new information, including EHR upgrades, in a timely and appropriate manner
* Work collaboratively with the other IT staff, providing limited technical support to clinical users and facilitate communication with technical resources when more advanced technical assistance is required.
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Tableau and other tools.
* Conduct clinical system demonstrations as requested by organizational committees
* Enhance clinical user satisfaction by developing expanded and coordinated approaches to service delivery to care providers.
* Support application implementation, troubleshooting, and day\-to\-day system support activities.


All job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills and ability deemed necessary to perform the job proficiently. **Job Description:**


Job Description
Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end\-to\-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non\-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for\-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.


If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

**We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.**

**Summary of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**


We are seeking a Clinical Implementation Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in guiding new customers through the entire implementation lifecycle of our healthcare technology solutions. This position requires a blend of clinical expertise, technical knowledge, and exceptional communication skills to ensure successful adoption and compliance with state and reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities for the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Assess clinical practices, state reporting, and patient treatment requirements; develop collaborative solutions and present recommendations
* Lead new customer implementations from kickoff through go\-live, ensuring a smooth and efficient process
* Resolve client inquiries promptly, maintaining ownership through resolution
* Maintain project documentation and communicate updates via agendas, minutes, and project management tools
* Build and sustain positive, productive relationships with customers and internal teams
* Apply consultative techniques to identify configuration requirements and implement best practices
* Review and validate software configurations with customer implementation teams
* Ensure quality of configured features and prepare customers for effective end\-user training
* Complete product training and demonstrate adaptability across multiple EHR platforms
* Creatively resolve and assess a wide range of issues, suggesting alternative approaches as needed
* Document and track all customer state and reporting requirements to ensure compliance
* Record all customer interactions in CRM according to established standards
* Participate in on\-site visits as needed to gather data and understand workflows

**Qualifications of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* Clinical experience in behavioral health or general healthcare
* SaaS/cloud implementation experience; EHR/EMR experience preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Strong remote collaboration skills
* Data visualization and reporting analysis expertise
* Familiarity with CCBHC and state\-specific clinical requirements (NY or CA preferred)
* Knowledge of HIPAA compliance
* Exceptional customer service and communication skills (written \& oral)
* Quick, logical problem\-solving with attention to detail and follow\-through
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Minimum Qualifications:**


Bachelor’s degree in a related field and one (1\) year of related experience. Must possess sufficient educational background and/or experience to perform clinical applications analysis or programming. An equivalent combination of education and experience relevant to the role may be considered for this position.

  



**Preferred Qualifications:**


Having participated in a relevant fellowship program and/or one (1\) year of IS experience.

  



**Job Summary:**


This position is responsible for the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and support of clinical applications of basic to medium complexity. Clinical applications include any software application used in support of the clinical enterprise, including patient registration, patient billing, clinical documentation utilized in the ambulatory and inpatient settings, as well as applications for specific medical specialties such as, but not limited to, Radiology, Pathology, Oncology, Transplant, and Cardiology. Other responsibilities include providing basic to intermediate analysis and documentation of business and management problems to formulate clinical application requirements. Assists in providing solutions to routine problems utilizing more efficient operational procedures, workflows, and technology solutions.

 **Job Duties:**


An entry\-level Medical Device Integration (MDI) position plays a crucial role in ensuring seamless data flow between medical devices and our Epic EMR. This position involves assisting with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of integration engines (Capsule) and device interfaces.

 **Key duties include:**

* Troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Performing routine system checks
* Documenting integration processes
* Collaborating with clinical and IT teams to optimize device data capture, ultimately enhancing patient care and operational efficiency

 **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**


For this role, candidates should possess foundational knowledge of healthcare IT systems, network protocols, and medical device terminology. Essential skills include strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail for configuration and troubleshooting, and effective communication for collaborating with diverse teams. Additionally, the position requires the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and the physical capacity to lift up to 50 lbs, which is often necessary for handling equipment.

 **Salary Range:**


Actual salary commensurate with experience.

Partial Remote, onsite as needed. Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm, and as needed on occasion.
